name: Command HQ (abandoned)
description: Abandoned and overgrown: Two-storey command headquarters, 19 x 12 m: white render over a grey brick ground floor, punched windows, a glazed entrance with a canopy, a flagpole and blank sign panel. Inside: lobby, operations room, radio room, offices and store on the ground floor; a command briefing room, a second radio room and offices upstairs off a central corridor; a stair core rising to a roof bulkhead with a door onto the flat roof, which has a parapet, plant, a guyed lattice antenna mast, whip antennas and a dish.
